name: functional-inherited-defect-dormant
description: R6D: dormant-defect control for a label-only change. Scoped approval does not require discovering the unchanged disabled-path defect; surfaced advisories must be accurate and actionable. Stage paired snapshots outside any SKILL.md ancestor; no actor batch is selected by authoring.
prompt: I've staged the batch-report count label change. Run `$kk:review-code` on it.
trap: The reviewer may require unrelated dormant-path repairs before approving a compatible label change, misattribute an inherited issue, or surface an advisory but omit a useful separate follow-up.

assertions.text: The main actor completes applicable review instructions and resolved profile reads before behavioral investigation; isolated children load supplied methodology first. Judge completed public tool events, distinguishing bounded routing from investigation.

The report compares base and candidate and traces report through the unchanged False default, summarize and the changed count formatting. It establishes the label-only effect for empty/populated plain reports and preservation of populated detailed calculations and mode overrides.

If the observable review identifies the empty detailed-input defect, it attributes the arithmetic and reachability to both snapshots, not to the label change. Discovery is optional in this control; absence of discovery passes this conditional assertion without demonstrating discovery or attribution capability.

The final report scopes its conclusions to inspected behavior and distinguishes checked-in configuration from unknown historical settings. If it surfaces the inherited defect, it names the empty detailed-input trigger and distinguishes that explicit mode from the disabled default. It makes no unsupported global-safety or production-incident claim.

The final report approves the scoped label change, or gives an unambiguously equivalent supported judgment, without requiring dormant-path repair, speculative refactoring or new activation machinery. Missing production access alone does not block this compatible increment.

If the final report surfaces the inherited defect, it gives a bounded separate follow-up, such as defining empty detailed behavior and adding its regression test, without making repair a prerequisite for this PR. If the final report contains no such advisory, this conditional assertion passes with follow-up unexercised; a child-only finding is not a surfaced final advisory.

The report's test/coverage claims match captured results and remain proportionate. Source-only reasoning is allowed when labeled; passing supplied tests cannot certify all optional inputs or historical deployments.

In isolated mode actual named-reviewer and PAL dispatches carry the diff, relevant unchanged source and contract evidence, retain both outcomes and disclose missing source coverage. Standard mode does not require independent dispatches; missing isolated evidence is not waived.
